There are two metal containers. One has a dull black surface and the other has a shiny white
surface.
Before heating, the air inside the metal containers is at the same temperature.
The Bunsen burner flame is the same distance from each metal container. The Bunsen burner
flame emits infrared radiation and heats the metal containers for three minutes.
Explain the difference between the temperatures of the air inside the two metal containers
after heating for three minutes.
